title: A pain day: find the one thing that needs me, and who is waiting on whom
goal: It's a pain day. Open Home and find, in under a minute, the one thing that needs me and who is waiting on whom.

persona.name: tired-returner-keyboard
persona.story: You know this app a little. Today you hurt and want to do the least possible. You use the keyboard, you read little, and you stop when you have the answer.

steps.say: Find the way to what is waiting on me
Open the first thing waiting on me
